content.en_US:
A flood-formed multiblock like the PWR: build the shell, fill it with battery and capacitor blocks, right-click the controller. Failures outline the bad blocks in red for three seconds.

Shape: a solid box with all three sides at least 3, six faces sealed, no hollow interior. Maximum 4,096 blocks.

Controller and ports must sit in a face centre - never on an edge or corner.

Charge and discharge rate is set by the WEAKEST battery in the structure. Adding batteries only adds capacity. Mixing in one weak cell drags the whole array down.

Capacitors multiply the rate: gold 1.1/1.3, niobium 1.4/1.8, tantalum 1.8/2.5, schrabidate 2.5/5.

Only formed port shells connect to cables; plain casing does not. Breaking any shell block disassembles the array and returns the parts.

Battery and capacitor blocks store nothing on their own.

See also:
[[Electric Blast Furnace|Electric Blast Furnace]]
content.zh_CN:
和 PWR 一样的成型多方块: 搭外壳、往里塞电池和电容元件、右键控制器成型。失败时会用红框标出错格三秒。

形状: 三边都至少 3 的实心长方体, 六面封死, 内部不能有空腔, 最多 4,096 格。

控制器和端口只能放在某个面的内部区域, 不能落在棱或角上。

充放速率由组内最弱的那块电池决定, 多堆电池只加容量。混进一块弱电池会拖垮整组。

电池和电容方块单独放着不存电。

另见:
[[电力高炉|Electric Blast Furnace]]
